paite: Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpin’n azak in solomon thuhaksa pipi a ettel tum in nungzui mi tampi toh sangawngsaute a gimlim leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua in Jerusalem ah ahohtou a: Solomon kiang atuntouh in, alungsim a om tengteng suahsiang vek in ahoupih hi.
heading: Sheba Kumpinu Hong Vehna / (1 Kum 10.1-13)

paite: Huan Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a: Solomon in adawn theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
Huchi in Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pilna leh a-inn lam amuh in,
adohkan a nek dingte, asikhate tutdante, anasemte nasepdante, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite leh akivatdante uh, TOUPA' inn a hohtouhnate, alungmang hial hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildan thuthang ka gam a ka zak adik mahmah ahi.
Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen kia uh ka um thei kei a, ngai in, na pilna thupidan akimkhat leng ahon na hilh kei uh: na minthanna ka zakte nakpi in na khup hi.
Na mite nak hamphat na uh e, hiai na sikha na kiang a om gige a na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete hampha hi na tel uh e!

TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak, akumpipa ding a alaltutphah a hon tusakpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen: na Pathian in Israelte tangtawn a hihkip ding in a-it a, huaiziak in diktattak a vaihawm ding in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ahi ve," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim tampi mahmah leh suangmantamte apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang himhim a-om ngei kei hi.
Huan Solomon sikhate leh Huram sikhate Ophir a kipan a dangka-eng va pote'n algum sing leh suangmantam ahon pua uhi.
Kumpipa'n algum sing TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding leh lasa mite a ding a kaihging leh pekging ding in abawl a: huchibang Judah gam ah tuma lam in amu ngei kei uhi.
Sheba kumpinu'n athil apiak sim louh in kumpipa Solomon in adeihdeih ape sam a, huchi in agam lam ah aheute toh apai nawnta uhi.
Huchi in Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng hong lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk buk ahi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Hauhsakna / (1 Kum 10.14-25)

paite: Mi ompolhte leh sumsin mite hon tawi sim het louh in: huan, Arabia kumpipa tengteng leh gam ukpate'n Solomon kiang ah dangka-engte, dangkasikte ahon tawi sek uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekthoh in lum lian chi zanih abawl a, lum lian khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk abei hi.
Dangka-eng sukpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat zel ah dangka-eng shekel zathum abei a; huaite Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
Huan kumpipa'n Saihapak laltutphah thupitak abawl behlap a, dangka siang ngen in aluan hi.
Laltutphah a akaltouhna siksan gukte, laltutphah toh azop, dangka-eng khe ngaknate, aban ngakna bul a ding humpinelkai lim nihte a-om hi.
Siksan guk lang tuak tung ah humpinelkai sawm-le-nih adingh uhi. Huchibang koi lai gam ah leng abawl ngei kei uh.
Kumpipa Solomon nou tengteng dangka-eng vek ahi a, Lebanon gammang inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng siang vek ahi; Solomon dam lai in dangkasik bangmah in asim kei uhi.
Kumpipa'n longhon, Huram sikhate, Tarshish a hohsek kikoppih anei a, kum thum hal zel in, Tarshish longhon in dangka-eng, dangkasik, saiha, zawng leh utongte, ahon po sek hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung kumpipa tengteng hauhsakna leh pilna lam ah akhup vek hi.
Huchi in Pathian in alungtang a akoih, apilna thu ngaikhe ding in, kumpipa tengteng in Solomon ahon zuan huthut uhi.
Kum teng a piak bikhiah nei in dangkasik tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puante, galvante, gimlimte, sakolte, sabiltungte ape zel uhi.
Huan Solomon in sakol leh kangtalai koihna mun sangli anei a, huan sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate ah, Jerusalem kumpipa kiangte ah a-omsak hi.
Huchi in lui a kipan a Philistia gam leh Aigupta gam tan a kumpipa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
erusalem ah kumpipa'n dangkasikte suang bang mai a tam in a-omsak a, sidar singte phaizang a theipite bang lel a ngaih in a-omsak hi.
Solomon a ding in sakolte Aigupta a kipan leh gam chih a kipan in ahon la zel uhi.

Solomon tanchin dangte abul a kipan atawp tanpha in, zawlnei Nathan gelh tanchinbu ah, Shilon mi Ahijah genkholhna bu ah, Nebat tapa Jeroboam tungtang thu a zawlnei Iddo mengmuh gelhna bu ah atuang kei maw?
heading: Solomon Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (1 Kum 11.41-43)

paite: Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israel mi tengteng tung ah kum sawmli vai ahawm hi.
Solomon bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apa David khua ah avui ua, asik in atapa Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
